businesses.business: AI-powered recommendation and performance advertising platform

offering_description.value: Operates an AI-driven advertising and content recommendation platform that places sponsored content and ads on publishers' websites and apps. Sells to advertisers and serves publishers, sharing revenue with them. Delivers via proprietary technology, data and direct publisher integrations.

primary_products.value: content recommendation platform; advertising platform for advertisers; onsite personalization software for publishers; news and homepage feed for devices

primary_services.value: digital ad placement and campaign management; ad monetization for publishers

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, agencies and brands buying ad placements, publishers, media owners and device makers monetizing content

end_markets.value: digital advertising; online media and publishing; e-commerce; mobile devices

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: advertisers pay per click, action or impression for ads on publisher properties; commissions or management fees: retained share of ad revenue after paying publisher partners
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: ad tech platform connecting advertisers with publisher inventory, sold to advertisers and publishers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Israel, Asia-Pacific and other regions with publishers worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: recommendation ads, publisher monetization and onsite personalization tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to advertisers, agencies and publishers; online: self-serve advertiser platform

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and advertising rules such as GDPR, CCPA and FTC advertising disclosure rules
